anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved: both outputs report the rejected push exactly once, state it is not retried or forced, skip the description edit and closure question, preserve the worktree, say Member PRs #13, #14 left open, and return to the menu; both also withhold row 1 on divergence with the Withheld line, stop on the #14 exit-1 case with the literal ccccccc rewritten-history message, treat exit 128 as a command error rather than divergence, and state that rows 2-6 never ask the closure question and leave members open. Two small wording notes for the After text, neither of which moves a fact: the divergence variant now asserts the aaaaaaa-vs-origin/retry proof exits 0 and bakes the '(origin moved past the rework's base aaaaaaa)' suffix into the sample, whereas Before showed both exit outcomes - keep the 'exit 0 appends / exit 1 adds nothing' branch so the sample does not read as if the suffix is unconditional; and the Withheld line uses the placeholder `<origin7>` where the case asked for a literal 7-character alias like Before's `ooooooo`. Also, rows 2–6 in After rely on a single trailing “For each variant” line and drop Before's per-row “no absorbed-member closure” phrasing; keeping an explicit no-member-closure clause on at least row 4 (which mentions branch deletion) would make the never-close guarantee unambiguous while still delivering the ordered-PR-list change.
